title: FunctionalityDiscoverQuery
description: A family-neutral discovery request: a search term or an explicit source such as a URL, path, registry reference, or package.

configuration.description: Caller-supplied configuration material the family interprets as candidates (a client's own PLURNK_SCHEDULE_* environment, a local directory list). It contributes candidates with client-configuration provenance; it never becomes durable authority.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by a previous discover page.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates or preview items to return on one page.
